title: Zinusya operations
description: Private operational telemetry. Select one datasource and deployment. No overall health, delivery, payment or business-latency guarantee. Snapshot panels require fresh successful samples; missing data is Unknown.

panels.title: Metrics scrape
panels.description: Monitoring availability only. No data means Unknown, not application health.

panels.title: Current snapshot freshness
panels.description: Fresh requires successful collection, a nonzero last-success timestamp newer than 120s, age <=120s and up=1. Zero means unavailable/stale; no data means Unknown. Each family is independent.

targets.expr: ((up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_collection_success{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > 0) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > time() - 120) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_snapshot_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} <= 120)) or on(job, instance) (0 * up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}})

((up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_collection_success{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > 0) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > time() - 120) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_snapshot_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} <= 120)) or on(job, instance) (0 * up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}})

((up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_collection_success{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > 0) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > time() - 120) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_snapshot_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} <= 120)) or on(job, instance) (0 * up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}})

panels.title: Unresolved tasks
panels.description: Includes intentional user waits and uncertainty. Not runnable jobs or affected users. Values are hidden when the corresponding snapshot is unavailable or stale; gaps are not zeros.

targets.expr: zinusya_tasks_unresolved{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} and on(job, instance) ((up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_collection_success{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > 0) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > time() - 120) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_snapshot_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} <= 120))

panels.title: Oldest task acceptance age
panels.description: Time since acceptance, including intentional waits. Not time in state or end-to-end latency. Values are hidden when the corresponding snapshot is unavailable or stale; gaps are not zeros.

targets.expr: zinusya_tasks_oldest_accepted_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} and on(job, instance) ((up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_collection_success{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > 0) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > time() - 120) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_tasks_snapshot_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} <= 120))

panels.title: Unfinished outbox chunks
panels.description: Chunks, not messages or users. Task/outbox uncertainty may describe the same incident; do not sum them. Values are hidden when the corresponding snapshot is unavailable or stale; gaps are not zeros.

targets.expr: zinusya_outbox_unresolved{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} and on(job, instance) ((up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_collection_success{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > 0) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > time() - 120) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_snapshot_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} <= 120))

panels.title: Oldest outbox creation age
panels.description: Time since creation of the oldest unfinished chunk. Not Telegram delivery latency. Values are hidden when the corresponding snapshot is unavailable or stale; gaps are not zeros.

targets.expr: zinusya_outbox_oldest_created_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} and on(job, instance) ((up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_collection_success{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > 0) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > time() - 120) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_outbox_snapshot_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} <= 120))

panels.title: Due River jobs
panels.description: Only fixed due kind/state pairs. Excludes running and future-scheduled work. Not worker utilization. Values are hidden when the corresponding snapshot is unavailable or stale; gaps are not zeros.

targets.expr: zinusya_queue_due{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} and on(job, instance) ((up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_collection_success{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > 0) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > time() - 120) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_snapshot_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} <= 120))

panels.title: Oldest scheduling lateness
panels.description: Time past scheduled_at for due jobs, including overdue polls. Not global progress or business latency. Values are hidden when the corresponding snapshot is unavailable or stale; gaps are not zeros.

targets.expr: zinusya_queue_oldest_scheduled_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} and on(job, instance) ((up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_collection_success{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > 0) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} > time() - 120) and on(job, instance) (zinusya_queue_snapshot_age_seconds{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} <= 120))

panels.title: PostgreSQL pool connections
panels.description: Local pgx statistics, including the instance-lock connection. Pool counts do not prove database readiness or worker utilization.

panels.title: Returned worker callbacks / second
panels.description: Normally returned Work callbacks, including callback-owned cleanup. Outcomes are callback classifications, not later River disposition or business completion.

panels.title: Returned callback p95
panels.description: Histogram estimate for normally returned callbacks, aggregated by kind across outcomes. Not user response or task completion latency. No observations means undefined, never zero.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, kind) (rate(zinusya_worker_attempt_duration_seconds_bucket{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}}[$__rate_interval]))) and on() (up{job="integrations/zinusya",instance=${instance:doublequote}} == 1)

panels.title: Positive introspection cache hit ratio
panels.description: Trusted JWTs only. Zero lookups gives an undefined ratio, not a zero hit rate. Cache disabled can legitimately produce misses. Not IAM availability.

panels.title: Unexpired credential fallback decisions / second
panels.description: Successful singleflight renewal decisions using an unexpired credential after a transient failure. Not caller count or all IAM failures.
